name: Corn wine
summary: The small hot cup VnExpress drinks with sour shrimp at the lake. It does not say this is the leaf-yeast wine or the festival glutinous wine.
origin: With the sour shrimp. VnExpress, 2 December 2014.
taste: VnExpress calls the corn wine a little hot beside the sour shrimp.
howToEat: A small cup beside tôm chua. VnExpress calls it a little hot. A strength was not printed.
Whether it is rượu men lá is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Bo Lu and Pac Ngoi, with the sour shrimp.
